packageRules.description: pion/rtp v2.0.0 is an abandoned 2020 tag; upstream (and pion/webrtc v4) stay on v1
server-sdk-go v2.20.0 needs replace directives (livekit/webrtc-pion fork on dtls/v4) that don't apply to consumers; revisit when upstream pion/webrtc moves to dtls/v4 or the SDK drops the replaces
Base images: majors only, so minor/patch bumps don't invalidate the Docker build cache

Gradle (wrapper distribution + AGP): majors only. A minor/patch bump throws away the id=gradle-home Docker cache (a fresh ~130 MB distribution download in CI) and AGP minors can move the required build-tools version
Node.js (base images, actions/setup-node, @types/node): majors only, same as the other base images
pnpm (CI + Dockerfiles): majors only, so all pins move together and the Docker cache isn't busted weekly

customManagers.description: pnpm pin in Dockerfiles (`npm install -g pnpm@x.y.z`), kept in step with pnpm/action-setup in CI
